column3: Close to the Hebrew; וְשַׁבֵּחַ (“I praised”) is rendered “I praised.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it is the envy of a man from his neighbor” is rendered “a man is envied by his neighbor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “striving of wind” is rendered “grasping for the wind.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “he never asks,” and “an evil task” is rendered “a grave misfortune.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “alone.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the house of the prisoners” is rendered “prison.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all whom he was before” is rendered “all the people over whom he was made king.”
